flows:
Navigate to https://payloan.vercel.app then A visitor reports a bug in the web app at https://payloan.vercel.app . Their report, in their own words: "If I type an address that does not exist, like /this-page-does-not-exist, I get the raw error page of the host instead of the own not-found page of the app with a way back home."
Do what the report describes, the way a normal visitor would.
Rules: read-only. Do not sign in, do not create an account, do not submit any form that sends data, do not buy anything.
Assert that the reported bug is really present: what the report says goes wrong does go wrong.

remark: assert: The reported bug is present: https://payloan.vercel.app/this-page-does-not-exist

Confirmed that the error page does not provide a visible link or button to return home.
